required_spectrum_schema.eigenvalue: positive selected eigenvalue of the gauge-factor Laplace/Dirac/threshold operator
required_spectrum_schema.multiplicity: selected multiplicity, default allowed by calculator is 1.0

no_knob_rules: Operator blocks, domains, spectra, and index weights must be selected before electroweak comparison.
Observed lambda_12, sin^2(theta_W), alpha_EM, or measured gauge couplings may not be used to fill spectra.
Universal determinant constants may be tracked but cannot affect the weak split.

D_Qa.gauge_role: Q_a component carried by the U(3)_a/SU3 stack in the hypercharge embedding

ghost_and_quotient_rule.rule: non-abelian Faddeev-Popov quotient determinant must be included with BRST-compatible sign/subtraction

missing_for_closure: selected SU3-stack connection and curvature endomorphism
selected gauge-fixing condition and ghost operator
selected physical domain and boundary/quotient conditions
selected eigenvalues, multiplicities, and index weights

operator_form.principal_laplace_type_part: connection Laplace-type operator on the selected SU3-stack gauge fluctuation bundle
operator_form.schematic_form: D = Pi_phys (nabla_A^* nabla_A + E_curv + gauge_fixing_terms + ghost_measure_terms) Pi_phys

physical_quotient.projector: Pi_phys projected SU3-stack coherent sector, restricted before determinant evaluation

trace_and_representation.trace_convention: gauge adjoint trace on SU3 stack; candidate factor C_A(SU3)=3

D_Qc.gauge_role: Q_c abelian circle stack entering Y=(1/6)Q_a-(1/2)Q_c

ghost_and_quotient_rule.rule: abelian Faddeev-Popov determinant is field-independent; any universal constant must be discarded from weak-split accounting
